<?php
// E2E probe (test only): resolves keys for several settings shapes and records what an outgoing request would carry.
// Uses obviously fake placeholder values; nothing leaves the machine (HTTP is short-circuited).
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( empty( $_GET['cardz3n_e2e_probe'] ) ) { return; }
	$live = array( 'live_security_key' => 'LIVE-SEC', 'live_tokenization_key' => 'LIVE-TOK' );
	$cases = array(
		'test_mode_live_keys_only'   => array_merge( array( 'test_mode' => 'yes' ), $live ),
		'test_mode_unified_only'     => array( 'test_mode' => 'yes', 'security_key' => 'LIVE-SEC', 'tokenization_key' => 'LIVE-TOK' ),
		'test_mode_live_and_test'    => array_merge( array( 'test_mode' => 'yes', 'test_security_key' => 'TEST-SEC', 'test_tokenization_key' => 'TEST-TOK' ), $live ),
		'live_mode_live_keys'        => array_merge( array( 'test_mode' => 'no' ), $live ),
	);
	$bodies = array();
	add_filter( 'pre_http_request', function ( $pre, $args ) use ( &$bodies ) {
		$bodies[] = isset( $args['body'] ) ? (string) $args['body'] : '';
		return array( 'headers' => array(), 'body' => 'response=3&responsetext=stub', 'response' => array( 'code' => 200, 'message' => 'OK' ), 'cookies' => array(), 'filename' => null );
	}, 10, 2 );
	$out = array();
	foreach ( $cases as $name => $settings ) {
		$bodies = array();
		$client = new \Cardz3n_Gateway\Api_Client( $settings );
		$client->validate_credentials();
		$joined = implode( '&', $bodies );
		$out[ $name ] = array(
			'security'      => $client->security_key(),
			'tokenization'  => $client->tokenization_key(),
			'has'           => $client->has_credentials(),
			'requests'      => count( $bodies ),
			'sent_live_key' => false !== strpos( $joined, 'LIVE-SEC' ),
		);
	}
	header( 'Content-Type: application/json' );
	echo wp_json_encode( $out );
	exit;
}, 20 );
